name: ETSI Open Source MANO (OSM)
description: ETSI-hosted project providing an open source NFV Management and Orchestration (MANO) software stack aligned with ETSI NFV standards. Supports cloud-native orchestration with Docker-based deployment.

docker_support.docker_evidence: OSM installations use pre-built docker images. Installation creates multiple docker containers: NBI, RO, LCM, MON, POL, and supporting services. Configured via /etc/osm/docker/docker-compose.yaml.

eval_notes: The reference ETSI NFV MANO implementation. Release NINETEEN (Feb 2026) extends cloud-native orchestration. Complex multi-service docker-compose. Good for testing NFV lifecycle management, VNF onboarding, and network service orchestration.
